sn23.12:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Māradhammo Māradhammo ti bhante vuccati || || Katamo nu kho bhante Māradhammo ti || || Rūpaṃ kho Rādha Māradhammo vedanā Māradhammo saññā Māradhammo saṅkhārā Māradhammo viññāṇam Māradhammo || || Evam passaṃ Rādha || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Aniccam
